title: 第21章 藏拙的开始第22章 逼婚

“噗通！”
李府后院，什么东西落水的声音响起，溅起了一丈余高的水花。
“哟，第十一次。”
湖边，张邋遢幸灾乐祸地坐在那里，一边喝酒，一边说风凉话。
“张老头，你这张嘴真是惹人厌。”
李子夜狼狈爬上岸，气喘吁吁躺在地上，道，“你说老秦怎么还不回来，都快十天了。”
“或许不顺利吧。”
张邋遢轻声一叹，道，“太学宫是儒首的地盘，普天之下，谁又能从儒首手中拿走东西。”
“不止一次听你提起什么儒首，他很厉害吗？”
李子夜不解道，他见过人中，最厉害的便是这张老头还有他那仙子师父，其他的高手，他其实知晓的并不多。
“何止是厉害。”
张邋遢感慨道，“若是在大商都城中，儒首就是天下第一人。”
“这么厉害？”李子夜惊讶道。
“大商都城，儒首从来不败，是因为大商都城是天下儒生的聚集地，气运浑厚，儒首身为天下儒者之师，可借助儒门气运，无人可敌。”张邋遢解释道。
“气运是什么？”李子夜疑惑道。
“一种虚无缥缈的东西。”
张邋遢想了想，说道，“就像这天地灵气一般，看不到摸不着，却又真实存在，唯有到了儒首那样的境界，方才能够借助这气运之力，常人，做不到。”
“你和老秦也不行？”李子夜诧异道。
“不行。”

张邋遢平静道，“境界不够。”
“你们不都是剑仙了吗？难道还有比仙剑更高的境界吗？”李子夜不解道。
“有。”
张邋遢平静道，“人体有五脏，对应修行者的五神藏，每开一座神藏，便会踏入全新的境界，所以，修炼一途，其实一共有着五境，而我和秦婀娜都是开辟到第五座神藏，也就是第五境的武者，至于剑仙之名，不过俗人代称。”
说到这里，张邋遢语气一顿，继续道，“传说中，第五境之上，还有更高的境界，五脏凝练五气，走到这一步的大修行者，练五气、聚三花，大成之日，举霞飞升，凡人成仙。”
“怎么感觉这么扯淡？”
李子夜震惊道，“真有飞升成仙的？”
“没有见过。”
张邋遢淡淡道，“其实，我也觉得是扯淡，听听就行，千年来，也只有儒首，可能触及到第五境之上的境界。”
“那儒首岂不是天下无敌了？”李子夜咂舌道。
“至少，在大商都城，儒首不可敌。”
张邋遢点头道，“不过，儒首极少走出都城，其真实境界究竟有没有越过第五境，又或者，越过第五境多少，无人可知。”
“那千年前的初代剑神呢？”李子夜似乎想起什么，问道。
“应该和儒首境界差不多。”
张邋遢想了想，说道，“时隔太久，没有人能够确定。”
“真是羡慕。”
李子夜感慨了一句，又不免有些担忧道，“儒首这么厉害，老秦不会出什么事吧？”
“那倒不会。”
张邋遢摇了摇头道，“儒首不是嗜杀之人，况且，以秦婀娜的实力，就算打不过，应该也能脱身。”
“公子。”

两人的话声刚落，后院外，一名小厮快步走来，急声道，“都城来的信。”
李子夜闻言，面露诧异，伸手接过信。
然而，很快，李子夜脸色便阴沉下来，眸中寒意大盛。
“发生何事了？”

"Plop!"
In the backyard of the Li Mansion, the sound of something falling into the water was heard, and water splashed more than ten feet high.
"Yo, the eleventh time."
By the lake, Zhang Ruo sat there gloating over his misfortune, drinking and making sarcastic remarks.
"Old man Zhang, your mouth is really annoying."
Li Ziye crawled ashore in embarrassment, lay on the ground panting, and said, "Why don't you tell me why Lao Qin hasn't come back? It's been almost ten days."
"Maybe it didn't go well."
Zhang Slutty sighed softly and said, "The Taixue Palace is the territory of the Confucian leader. No one in the world can take anything away from the Confucian leader."
"I heard you mention the Confucian leader more than once. Is he very powerful?"
Li Ziye wondered. Among the people he had ever seen, the most powerful ones were the old man Zhang and his fairy master. He actually didn't know much about the other masters.
"It's more than awesome."
Zhang Sulu sighed with emotion, "If he were in the capital city of Great Shang Dynasty, the Confucian leader would be the best person in the world."
"So powerful?" Li Ziye said in surprise.
"In the capital of Great Shang, the Confucian leader has never been defeated. This is because the capital of Great Shang is a gathering place for Confucian scholars in the world and has strong luck. The Confucian leader is the teacher of the Confucian scholars in the world. He can rely on the luck of the Confucian sect to make him unbeatable." Zhang Sulu explained.
"What is luck?" Li Ziye asked doubtfully.
"Something ethereal."
Zhang Sultan thought for a while and said, "Just like the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, it is invisible and intangible, but it is real. Only those who have reached the level of Confucianism can use the power of luck. Ordinary people cannot do this."
"You and Lao Qin can't do it either?" Li Ziye said in surprise.
"No."
Zhang Slutty said calmly, "The realm is not enough."
"Aren't you all sword immortals? Is there a higher realm than the immortal sword?" Li Ziye asked confused.
"Yes."
Zhang Sulu said calmly, "The human body has five internal organs, which correspond to the five divine treasures of the practitioner. Every time you open a divine treasure, you will enter a new realm. Therefore, there are actually five realms in the journey of cultivation. Qin Grace and I are both warriors who have opened the fifth divine treasure, which is the fifth realm. As for the name of Sword Immortal, it is just a common name."
At this point, Zhang's sloppy tone paused and continued, "According to legend, there is a higher realm beyond the fifth realm, where the five internal organs condense the five qi. A great practitioner who has reached this stage practices the five qi and gathers the three flowers. On the day of great success, he will soar in the clouds and become an immortal."
"Why does it feel so nonsense?"
Li Ziye said in shock, "Is there really someone who ascends to immortality?"
"Never seen it."
Zhang Slutty said calmly, "Actually, I think it's nonsense, just listen to it. For thousands of years, only the Confucian leader has possibly touched a realm above the fifth realm."
"Isn't the Confucian leader invincible in the world?" Li Ziye clicked his tongue.
"At least, in the great commercial capital, the Confucian leader is invincible."
Zhang sloppily nodded and said, "However, the Confucian leader rarely leaves the capital. No one knows whether his true realm has surpassed the fifth realm, or how much."
"What about the first-generation sword god from thousands of years ago?" Li Ziye seemed to be remembering something and asked.
"It should be similar to the realm of Confucian leader."
Zhang Sultan thought for a while and said, "It's been so long that no one can be sure."
"I'm so envious."
Li Ziye sighed with emotion, but couldn't help but worry a little, "The Confucian leader is so powerful, nothing will happen to Lao Qin, right?"
"That won't happen."
Zhang Sloppy shook his head and said, "The Confucian leader is not a murderous person. Besides, with Qin Grace's strength, even if she cannot be beaten, she should be able to escape."
"Son."
As soon as the two of them finished speaking, a boy walked quickly outside the backyard and said urgently, "Letter from the capital."
Hearing this, Li Ziye looked surprised and reached out to take the letter.
However, Li Ziye's face soon turned gloomy, and his eyes became cold.
"What happened?"
